evidence: We performed ALD at the relatively low temperature of 105 °C using trimethylphosphino-trimethyl gold (III) as the metal precursor and ozone and water as co-reactants. The metal precursor bubbler and the line connecting the bubbler to the reactor were heated to 85 °C and 95 °C, respectively. All the reactants were transferred to the reaction chamber with a nitrogen flow rate of 0.5 lit/min.
